subject: Problem when running lavaan via SAS

messages.author: 6408bed780b146f3
messages.subject: Problem when running lavaan via SAS
parts:
Hi, 

I'm running PROC IML in SAS to call R and install.packages fails.
I use this code:

proc iml;
submit / R;
options(repos = list(CRAN='http://cran.r-project.org'))
list.of.packages <- c('lavaan')
new.packages <- list.of.packages[!(list.of.packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new.packages)) install.packages(new.packages, dependencies=TRUE)
suppressMessages(library(lavaan))
endsubmit;
run; 

and I get the warnings/errors: 

WARNING: R: Warning message:
WARNING: R: In install.packages(new.packages, dependencies = TRUE) :
WARNING: R:   installation of package 'lavaan' had non-zero exit status
ERROR: R: Error in library(lavaan) : there is no package called 'lavaan'
ERROR: R: Calls: suppressMessages -> withCallingHandlers -> library

Any ideas why it is not working?
Thanks.

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Problem when running lavaan via SAS
parts:
Installing packages in R can be tricky, sometimes it doesn't install for some reason, e.g. dependencies fail and you need to install these separately. 

My guess is that that is what is happening here - it's trying to install lavaan, but it's failing to install for some reason - it's not telling you, it's just saying it had non-zero exit status. Can you install lavaan in R first, then you don't need to try to install it with SAS (and you'll see what errors you get).

J

parts:
Calling R from SAS is really weird. Wink twice if you are held captive by the SAS government cabal.

A different approach may be to ensure that the packages get installed and run from a known location, and then pass lower level .libPaths() to that known location.
